facts.text: I am planning a trip to Japan.
I booked a hotel in Kyoto through Booking.com.
My Kyoto hotel cost $800 for 7 nights.
I am interested in trying traditional Kyoto-style cuisine.
I am particularly interested in kaiseki.
I want kaiseki restaurants with an affordable price point around ¥5,000-¥10,000 per person.
I saw Kyoto-style yudofu in a previous message.
I am interested in trying yudofu during my stay in Kyoto.
I am staying at a hotel in Kyoto that I booked through Booking.com.
My Kyoto hotel cost $800 for 7 nights.
I want restaurants that offer yudofu with a nice view or atmosphere, perhaps near my hotel in Kyoto.
I want to know whether any of these restaurants are within walking distance from my hotel.
I am assuming my Booking.com hotel is a decent hotel in a central location.
I want the hotel's name or neighborhood so I can determine which restaurants are within walking distance.
